item.summary: Lebanon's government condemns as a "flagrant crime" the killing of the paramedics, one of whom featured in a BBC report.

item.title: US war on Iran was a 'mistake', says Reeves
item.summary: The chancellor's criticism follows a report that the conflict will hit the UK harder than other big economies.

item.title: Frank Gardner: What is China's role in the Iran war?
item.summary: BBC Security Correspondent Frank Gardner explains how the world's second-largest economy fits into the Gulf conflict.

item.summary: It follows a warning from the US president that America's trade deal with the UK "can always be changed".

item.title: Sri Lanka repatriates 238 Iranian sailors stranded after US torpedo attack
item.summary: The survivors of the US attack on Iranian vessel Iris Dena, which claimed the lives of 104 people, were among those sent home.

item.title: Hamas rejects Gaza disarmament plan, Palestinian official says
item.summary: The official tells the BBC that the armed group will not move forward with talks until Israel fully complies with its commitments.

item.title: Iran carried out highest number of executions in decades
item.summary: Organisations warn many more people could be executed in the wake of the anti-government protests which swept Iran earlier this year.

item.title: French cement giant guilty of financing IS and other militant groups in Syria
item.summary: The French company paid $6.5m to jihadist groups to keep its plant running in war-torn Syria, a Paris court heard.
